title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Read the briefing? Good, now here's your assignments.
original_zh: 任务情报都读过了吗？接下来开始分配位置。
translation: Брифинг прочитали? Хорошо, теперь распределим позиции.

title: Depart
original: Know your jobs? Then let's do this.
original_zh: 了解各自的职责了吗？那么，出发。

title: Begin Operation
original: I prefer to keep my fight quiet.
original_zh: 战斗时，我更喜欢保持沉默。

title: Deployment 2
original: I can handle this on my own.

title: 3-star Result
original: It's always reassuring to carry out your orders, Doctor.
original_zh: 博士，执行你的命令总是让人放心。
translation: Всегда успокаивает выполнять ваши приказы, Доктор.
